construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
Three 30-story towers. Developers filed two entitlement options, residential and the earlier office plan.

Earlier office plan (CEQAnet SCH 2021070496, NOP July 2021): demolish a three-story office building, parking kiosk and surface lot; build a 20-story commercial building up to 301 feet with two towers totaling 1,397,321 sq ft, about 50,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail and community uses and 1,347,321 sq ft of office.

San Jose Blog (Nov. 2024, citing Mercury News Oct. 24, 2024): site is the Valley Title lot at 300 S. First St. and 345 S. Second St. in SoFA; three towers of about 30 stories (about 300 feet), one cylindrical; about 18,400 sq ft of retail and 8,700 sq ft of residential amenities; developers keep an option for two 20-story office towers of about 1.32 million sq ft.
